resources.string: Check Android battery and background restrictions

If background monitoring stops, check the system battery and background activity restrictions for PodTide. Menu names and paths vary by phone manufacturer and Android version. The ColorOS path below is one example. PodTide cannot read this manufacturer-specific setting. Exempting the app from Android battery optimization does not confirm that background activity is fully allowed.
OPPO / ColorOS example: App details → Battery usage → Fully allow background activity
Open Apple Find Devices in your browser

Sign in on Apple Find Devices with the Apple Account paired with your AirPods, then select them. Apple may show a current or last known location. Playing a sound in the earbuds depends on their status. The webpage cannot ring the AirPods Pro 3 charging case. Precise direction and distance require a compatible iPhone.
